memory_candidates.content: When propagating a literal agent-contract bullet across many agent files with a lint check verifying it (the Check C/G/H pattern in lint-agent-contracts.sh), place the bullet-pair source as a new section in an EXISTING topically-adjacent pattern/contract document rather than creating a new file -- keeps net document count flat and matches the established generated-copy-source convention (no-task-references-bullet.md, plan-status-ownership.md). Use a curated, hand-maintained in-scope array in the lint (never a filename glob) with an inline comment recording excluded files and their per-file reasons plus the re-audit reproduce command verbatim, so a future auditor can re-derive the set without guessing.

A bash grep -F pattern anchor containing a literal backtick inside single quotes (e.g. grep -F 'arm a `Monitor` ...') triggers shellcheck SC2016 (info level) even though single quotes correctly prevent expansion of the backtick as command substitution. The established convention in this codebase is a '# shellcheck disable=SC2016' comment directly above the line, matching the existing SC1090/SC1091 disable-directive pattern used for dynamic sourcing elsewhere.

next_steps: Task fully implemented; no remaining phases. Deploy-tree regeneration from the source store is required before the propagated contract takes effect on a live agent dispatch (recorded as a recommendation, not performed by this task).
